title: MAX picked fields from different backup rows
description: Fix the query. For each database_name return finished_seq and size_mb from the same row: the latest successful backup by finished_seq; when finished_seq ties, choose the larger backup_id. Databases without successful backups are omitted. Return exactly three columns: database_name, finished_seq, size_mb. Sort by database_name ASC.
starter_sql:
SELECT database_name, MAX(finished_seq) AS finished_seq, MAX(size_mb) AS size_mb
FROM backups
WHERE status = 'success'
GROUP BY database_name
ORDER BY database_name ASC;
hints: MAX(finished_seq) and MAX(size_mb) are independent and may come from different rows.
First select one latest row per database, for example with ROW_NUMBER(), then return its fields.
solution_explanation: ROW_NUMBER ranks complete rows, ensuring finished_seq and size_mb come from the same selected backup.
